column3: MT 62:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “only toward God is my soul silence” is rendered “Truly my soul silently waits for God.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשְׂגַּבִּי (“my stronghold”) is rendered “my defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ (“from his eminence”) is rendered “from his high position.”
Close to the Hebrew; תִּקְוָתִי (“my hope”) is rendered “my expectation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “refuge” is rendered “defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּכְבוֹדִי (“my honor”) is rendered “my glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of Adam” and “sons of man” are rendered “men of low degree” and “Men of high degree,” and “breath” “vapor.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְעֹשֶׁק (“extortion”) is rendered “oppression,” and “bear fruit” “increase.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
